name: Ogai's Notes
descriptionTemplate: At battle start, shuffle a {Forbidden Truth} into the deck. Draw +[Arg1] each turn. After playing a Command Card, randomly grant {Perception Warp} to [Arg2] Command Cards each in the hand, Draw Pile, and Discard Pile that do not already have {Perception Warp}.
lore: The record contains 70 Mason prime numbers.
